notes.title: Street Cleaner 3 Dev Streams
notes.content:

Creaky Lantern artist and designer Brooks is regularly streaming development of the new game live on Twitch.tv every M/W/F around 1pm Pacific.  Other days may get thrown in for playing games with either Brooks or the Street Cleaner himself!

Follow us at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/creakylantern]https://www.twitch.tv/creakylantern[/url] to get notifications when streams happen, and come chat with us about the game, game development, or whatever.

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
The [i]Street Cleaner: The Video Game[/i] arcade cabinet has been a huge hit at live events, and we're bringing this feature to everyone so you can make your own Street Cleaner arcade experience!

Enabling Arcade Mode is a two step process:
[h2]1) Set up Arcade options[/h2]

To set up arcade options, launch the game with the "-arcade-config" switch (as seen below).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/7ab377c4cb1c49d2cec48059928c01996e744d3c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/cac3513689710b6a1aee6b1e1fc16d5504a95072.jpg[/img][/url]

The menu will no include "ARCADE OPTIONS".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/8d0f2648db44922de36aa35a32011208cae8e7d2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/3fa0bcbe3545bf36cf18350fdb3e95c3c80c6074.jpg[/img][/url]


Here, you can rebind they keyboard bindings for menu controls.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/76dac274a4286794dae7e03324371ca7282c27f1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/5ece46bc2391c16812ef5f8b2026e1011bf494bd.jpg[/img][/url]

Additionally, set the "COIN" entry to the input sent by the coin slot of your cabinet.
(Be careful! If you bind these keys in a way that makes it impossible to navigate menus, you can fix them by editing or deleting the config file in ~/AppData/Roaming/CreakyLantern/SCTVG/options.txt)

You can also set the following options:
Lives/Cred.: How many lives are given per credit inserted to play.
Timeout: If set to YES, if no input is detected during gameplay for 3 minutes, the game will return to the main menu.


[h2]2) Launch in Arcade mode[/h2]

To run in Arcade mode, launch the game with the "-arcade" switch (as seen below).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/6d392b732354fc76886953ad096a2a52f01e7ada.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/73bcb78244c40141aa6e573cb40f718d83f7cc61.jpg[/img][/url]


Arcade mode requires insertion of credits to play. If you unlock/have unlocked the Music Test, that will be available here as well.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/8146058961945ec14b65e021744b09c3290b79f0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/e9420e85993d69f6db3d4fee18b23eb6a6fffc74.jpg[/img][/url]

The game now plays using credits and lives. When you run out of lives you can insert a new credit to get more lives and continue playing, or you will return to the main menu.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/46dc9857772a988b2931abd039cb5dc96c5f358d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/ac37931cfa64e0e50e5174ffeefd328c9964db1a.jpg[/img][/url]

Enjoy!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Arcade style options to the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with backtracking into boss rooms that could result in clipping through floors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added an analog stick dead zone setting to the options.
The default was, and remains 30%. If you find the stick on your controller is too sensitive, try increasing the dead zone value.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
* Fixed in game and end game timing to display milliseconds with 3 digits, to better match leaderboard displays.
* Added a "-glmodern" command line options. By default the game uses the OpenGL 3.2 CORE profile for wide-ranging compatibility with older video cards. Use this command line switch if you are having OpenGL display issues.
* Added a "-fullvsync" command line option. This alters the game to use standard vertical synchronization instead of "swap control tear" synchronization. Use this command line switch if you are having problems recording or streaming the game.
* Added new unlockable game mode. Can you solve the puzzle and unlock Highland?

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a slight grace period to the down input to perform a dive kick.
Previously, kick input required strictly holding down, then pressing attack to perform. Now, attack can be pressed within a 6 frame window of releasing down while in the air to still perform a kick.
[*] Added more granular damage options to Assist mode to allow players to set a custom difficulty while playing. Options are now Normal (just like the normal game), Invincible (take no damage), Hardcore (single hit kills as in Hardcore mode), and 1, 2, 3, 4,  or 6. Where the numbered options denote how many pips of health are used when taking damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Street Cleaner: The Video Game Now Available!
notes.content:
It's finally time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/1c3736240624dba25d358e76adb24f683b0bd045.png[/img]
Time for everyone to take up the bat of the Street Cleaner and embark on the quest to track down a criminal kingpin and root out crime and injustice.

When the Street Cleaner project began, with the goal of paying homage to the action and vigilante films of the 1980's we never thought it would make it this far. When we talked about how any hit movie of the time would have sold off the video game rights for a quick buck, we laughed at the joke. But when we decided to make that game real, we put our hearts and souls into it. This isn't just a video game, this is the STREET CLEANER video game.

[url=https://streetcleaner.bandcamp.com/album/music-from-and-inspired-by-street-cleaner-the-video-game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/ffc8355f538af40b3098111e3affda5784d81f4e.jpg[/img][/url]
The soundtrack was composed by the man himself in FamiTracker, meaning it's not just an NES soundalike, it will actually play on an NES! However, the album isn't just the OST, it's the latest full Street Cleaner album release featuring not just the in game music, but a selection of tracks based on and inspired by it in all the pulse-pounding Street Cleaner dark synth glory. Buy the album on Bandcamp and you'll get a whole TEN additional bonus tracks of b-sides and other unused music intended for the game.
[url=https://streetcleaner.bandcamp.com/album/music-from-and-inspired-by-street-cleaner-the-video-game]Buy the Music From and Inspired By Street Cleaner The Video Game here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/53286dde277885342f808a44c239e6093b9a5003.png[/img]

Looking to the near future. While we couldn't get achievements and leaderboards in the game in time for launch, those will be coming soon!  Once Steam determines that the game is viable enough for trading cards, we'll be making those too. We still have some other amazing ideas for the game we'd like to do, and the more successful you all make the game, the easier it will be to make all those things happen!

Thank you all for your support, we hope you enjoy Street Cleaner: The Video Game as much as we enjoyed making it.
- The Creaky Lantern Games Team

notes.title: Street Cleaner: The Video Game Demo
notes.content:
[i]From the dark streets of San Diego to the deepest depths of the criminal underworld, control the Street Cleaner as he takes down outlaw scum in search of justice.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/8cf2188acc02222a69caecd97baadf6a48f1e031.jpg[/img]


[h1]About the Game[/h1]
Street Cleaner is a San Diego based dark synth artist who draws inspiration from the over-the-top action and vigilante films of the 1980s. What better way to build on that fictional universe than to make a [i]real[/i] 8-bit retro video game just as they would have back in the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/2a2e0636de71912e501953f43ec49ec5761e99c1.jpg[/img]


[h1]About the Demo[/h1]
While the full game will feature seven stages of platforming action, this demo takes you straight to the action of [b]Stage 4, the Sewers[/b]. There, you'll have to deal with ninjas, sewer 'gators, and giant flies before facing off against Master Feng, a lieutenant of the criminal organization and accomplished ninja who has mastered ancient wind techniques!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/417592515e1213dc6a46113fce2187f48b5444a0.jpg[/img]


[h1]Physical Copies![/h1]
In addition, we are now Kickstarting physical editions of both the game itself, and the official Street Cleaner Original Sound Tracks! That's right, [i]OSTs[/i]! Here's your one chance to own the game, the chiptune soundtrack AND the full-on heavy darksynth "Music From and Inspired By" album on Compact Disc.  Plus don't miss out on the Official Game Guide, a full color guide book featuring art, tips, and behind the scenes info on the game you won't get anywhere else. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/cd22be6993923834bdd26c9db6fa432642adc6a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/978c9e585621d2b8d28c1dfc5570408cd03bfc1d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/streetcleanergame/street-cleaner-the-video-game]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/f20caea0449c567877b8ab045c223290512f3945.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Wishlist Now![/h1]
If you like what you see, please add [i]Street Cleaner: The Video Game[/i] to your Steam wishlist so you can be notified just as soon as the full game launches!
